faq.q: Can I read fuel level remotely on a Honda Fit?
faq.a: Yes, through a DIMO device. The record lists Fuel Percentage (powertrainFuelSystemRelativeLevel) and Fuel Level in liters (powertrainFuelSystemAbsoluteLevel). Query them with a Vehicle JWT in the GraphQL Telemetry API.

faq.q: How do I track a Honda Fit with no connected services?
faq.a: Use a DIMO device, the DIMO LTE R1 for this vehicle. Once the owner shares the vehicle with your Developer License, exchange your Developer JWT for a Vehicle JWT through the Token Exchange API and query the Telemetry API.

faq.q: How do I detect idling on a Honda Fit?
faq.a: Query the Telemetry API segments resource with the idling detection mechanism, which requires a DIMO device. Idling segments are periods where engine RPM stays in the idle range, and you can set the upper bound with maxIdleRpm (default 1000).

faq.q: How do I verify Honda Fit mileage?
faq.a: With a DIMO device supplying the odometer signal, call the Attestation API odometer statement endpoint (POST /v2/attestation/odometer-statement/:tokenId). Then retrieve the signed statement through the Telemetry API attestations query.

faq.q: How do I detect harsh braking on a Honda Fit?
faq.a: Harsh braking is a listed event for the DIMO device. Create a webhook through the Vehicle Triggers API using the events service and the behavior.harshBraking metric name, then subscribe the vehicle. Webhooks are currently in public beta.

intro: DIMO provides a Honda Fit vehicle data API through a DIMO device, the DIMO LTE R1, for model years 2009 and newer. Coverage for this vehicle has been tested. DIMO gives developers API access to vehicle-state data: diagnostics, fault codes, battery and fuel health, odometer, and maintenance signals. DIMO adds vehicle-state depth on top of GPS tracking; it doesn't replace it.
